## 🚀 Feature Overview

Briefly describe the feature and its intended outcome.

## 📋 Implementation Checklist

Use this section to track remaining work. Check off items as they are completed.

### Phase 1: Foundation

- [ ] Research and design specifications
- [ ] Set up initial project structure/boilerplate
- [ ] Define core API or database schema

### Phase 2: Core Development

- [ ] Core logic implementation
- [ ] Basic UI/UX components
- [ ] Initial unit tests

### Phase 3: Refinement & Testing

- [ ] Edge case handling
- [ ] Integration testing
- [ ] Documentation updates
